title: Owner seat map and sprint friction log - May 2026
content:
Purpose: quick, sharable owner seating map + friction log to guide an ad-hoc 3-day sprint where we are juggling Dedicated rollout checks, console telemetry gaps, and a late customer rollback request. Use this as a working sheet during async handoffs and 15-min daily syncs.

How to use (1-paragraph): Paste this doc into a shared spreadsheet if you want columns. The table below is intentionally compact — owner = who will act if item becomes urgent, seat = who will cover the cross-functional ask during primary owner's planned absence, est effort = quick estimate in engineer-hours, friction level = low/med/high (operational/unknown risk), blocker note = short text, follow-up = immediate next step, handoff ETA = target time to get owner briefed.

Snapshot table (text rows):
- Row 1: "Route: dedicated-gpu-pool-health", owner: "Priya Shah (eng-sre)", seat: "Marco Reyes (platform)", est effort: "4h", friction: "med", blocker note: "observability probe intermittently 504s for 90s windows — affects canary", follow-up: "Marco to validate probe config + escalate to infra kernel team if persists", handoff ETA: "2026-05-11 16:00 PDT"
- Row 2: "Route: console-telemetry-store", owner: "Anika Patel (product-ops)", seat: "Sophie Lin (product-ops)", est effort: "2h", friction: "low", blocker note: "missing token-level cost on /v1/usage route for a small % of users", follow-up: "Anika to regenerate ETL mapping and re-run backfill", handoff ETA: "2026-05-12 10:30 PDT"
- Row 3: "Route: hosted-api-fallback-policy", owner: "Jared O'Neal (serving-runtime)", seat: "TBD - tag for oncall rotation", est effort: "6h", friction: "high", blocker note: "customer reported degraded quality when fallback to smaller quantized model triggers unexpectedly", follow-up: "Jared to run repro with customer prompt set and open rollback patch PR", handoff ETA: "2026-05-11 18:00 PDT"
- Row 4: "Route: billing-credit-adjustments", owner: "Rina Gomez (finance-and-legal)", seat: "Sophie Lin (product-ops)", est effort: "1.5h", friction: "low", blocker note: "one-off credit request tied to Dedicated burst overage", follow-up: "Rina to validate invoice + approve manual credit", handoff ETA: "2026-05-12 12:00 PDT"
- Row 5: "Route: private-deploy-onprem-install", owner: "Ethan Wu (private-deployments)", seat: "Marco Reyes (platform)", est effort: "8h", friction: "med", blocker note: "certificate chain mismatch in customer's air-gapped environment", follow-up: "Ethan to prepare patch and step-by-step remediation guide for SE", handoff ETA: "2026-05-12 22:00 PDT"

Quick totals (for planning):
- Sum of est effort: "21.5h" (rough)
- High friction items: 1 (hosted-api-fallback-policy)
- Items needing cross-team escalation: 2 (dedicated-gpu-pool-health, hosted-api-fallback-policy)

Scratch notes and context: 
- This sheet is intentionally minimal: capture ownership, immediate action and an ETA so on-call and rotation leads can triage quickly.
- If seat = "TBD" mark in Slack with @oncall and update before close-of-day.
- Avoid spinning up additional dedicated capacity until probe root cause is validated; otherwise cost spiral risk.

Open questions: 
1) Who is primary for weekend coverage if Priya is out? (Suggested: Marco take primary with SRE backup)
2) Can we commit to a fallback config change window (ETA for safe rollout) without breaking SLA for latency-sensitive customers?
3) Do we need a temporary quota gate on the hosted-api route to prevent repeated fallback churn?

Immediate next steps (today):
- 15:10 sync: owners listed above join quick triage (Sophie to host).
- Marco: validate GPU probe + post small findings in Slack thread by 17:00.
- Jared: start repro with customer prompt set and create initial branch for rollback candidate; notify product-ops if quality regression confirmed.

Archive guidance: convert to a formal tracker if any item remains open past 72 hours. Tag each row with ARCHIVE-IF-OPEN and owner will be assigned the archival task.

Notes-to-self (informal):
- Keep the table terse. Managers prefer simple constructs for handoffs.
- If this doc diverges into long runbook steps, move to confluence and reference here.

End of doc.
